title: Venezuelan-Style Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice pilaf infused with the vibrant spirit of Venezuela, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: quick fluffy venezuelan rice
ingredients.notes: can use leftover or day-old rice

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: smoked or sweet, whichever you prefer

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add cumin and paprika; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with spices.
Add hot water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the rice pilaf with a fork and stir in soy sauce, if using.
